latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release — provides Instagram caption extraction from public post and reel URLs.

- Added command-line script to scrape captions from Instagram posts and reels using instaloader.
- Outputs full caption along with metadata (owner, post type, likes, shortcode).
- Handles and reports errors (e.g., private posts, invalid URLs) with clear messages.
- Usage instructions and output formats provided in README.
- Removed legacy shell script and previous workflow files — now focused solely on scraping Instagram captions.
